name: saldo360
description: Atalhos para rodar o Saldo360 localmente: PostgreSQL e Authelia no Docker, API e frontend na máquina.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:auth && npm run setup:tools && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update -p src/Saldo360.Infrastructure -s src/Saldo360.Api -- --environment Development
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm start
scripts.build: dotnet build Saldo360.slnx && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
